item.name: Create an (or Alter an Existing) Api Integration

request.name: Create an (or Alter an Existing) Api Integration

description.content: Create an (or alter an existing) API integration. Note that API_KEY is not currently altered by this operation and is supported for a newly-created object only. Unsetting API_BLOCKED_PREFIXES is also unsupported.

The Snowflake Account API is a REST API that you can use to access, update, and perform certain actions on Account resource in Snowflake.
